title: A change_log export without the user_account_changes gate is reported as withheld, not as empty
note: NOT YET RUNNABLE as written, so it is known-red. The gate needs devices:execute in the grant ceiling (aiToolsExportPermissions.ts, change_log sensitiveGate). The harness grant is created by the seeded platform-admin partner admin, who holds devices:execute, so the frozen exportGrants always carry user_account_changes and no rows are withheld. Expressing the lack needs either a second harness user whose role has devices:read but not devices:execute granting Wisp (a harness change: another login, TOTP and approver device), or a product hook to narrow the ceiling. The sql_equals check below states the precondition and stays red until a world can express it; it is deliberately not marked precondition, because a failed precondition is an UNEXPECTED FAIL even for known-red. Once the world can lack the gate, flip expect to pass.

steps.name: launch
steps.text: Start an analysis across the whole Northwind Dental organization. Export the change log for the last 7 days and tell me how many user account changes there were.

steps.name: root-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: report
steps.text: What did the analysis find about user account changes?

checks.note: the run exported the change log

checks.sql: select (not coalesce(staged_inputs->'exportGrants'->'sensitiveGates' @> '["user_account_changes"]'::jsonb, false))::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and queued_at > {{since}} order by queued_at limit 1
checks.note: the world lacks the gate (red today: the harness grantor holds devices:execute)
the chat reply says rows were withheld
an absent permission must not read as 'nothing happened'
